senses.definition: n.[m.] flask (from gurgling sound of emptying, cf. Arabic بَقْبَقَةٌ gurgling sound; also Syriac ܒܰܓܒܽܘܓܳܐ, cantharus etc.)—abs. בַּקְבֻּק Je 19:10; cstr. id. 1 K 14:3 Je 19:1.
